gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth and tall, its lowercase filling the line. Bpmf Iansui above it looks hand-drawn, one squeezed line per stroke, and if the heading shrinks too small that charm gets lost.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-gf-bhutuka-expanded-o: BhuTuka Expanded One is a curvy text serif that slows reading to a stroll. Its literary weight is the pair's best quality, with Bpmf Iansui adding a hand-drawn, inviting lightness on top.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab is bookish and stretched out, its open counters breathing into the white space around each word. Bpmf Iansui looks hand-drawn above it, so keep that heading from shrinking.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru is a text serif with terminals that stop far from the stem. Its generous letterspace lets a long passage drift along slowly, while Bpmf Iansui keeps the top relaxed and hand-drawn.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-gf-orbit: Bpmf Iansui looks like toothpaste squeezed in one steady line, with an open counter opening on the s. Orbit below is a sans with floating characters; give the heading a bit more size.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-gf-padyakke-expanded-: Bpmf Iansui writes like a relaxed, hand-drawn line. Padyakke Expanded One answers with wide-mouthed, authoritative letters spread out like knots on a slack rope, so a tiny heading would get swallowed.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-gf-stint-ultra-expand: Relaxed and inviting, Bpmf Iansui hand-draws its heading in one squeezed, steady stroke. And Stint Ultra Expanded, a classic serif with floating characters and open counters, gives the pair its traditional, authoritative backbone.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-manrope: Loose hand, tidy gaps. Manrope handles the steady work with a sans body whose curves open brightly, while Bpmf Iansui does what it does best: warm, squeezed-line personality up top.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-montserrat: Bpmf Iansui has a hand-drawn stroke, like toothpaste squeezed out in one steady line. Montserrat's oversized, open counters sit beneath it, so give the heading plenty of size.
